name: Hetzner Object Storage
line: S3-compatible object storage with shared storage and egress allowances.

free.text: No free tier; €7.72/month while any bucket is active, even if empty

cells.metered: €7.72/month account base includes 1 TB storage and egress
cells.regions: Falkenstein, Nuremberg, or Helsinki; one site per bucket

sql.math: Hetzner Object Storage is not a database
Hetzner Object Storage is not a database

files.math: 100 GB is 0.1 TB, which is 72 TB-hours of storage and 0.1 TB of outbound data (egress). Both fit within the included amounts for 30 days, and upload and download requests (PUT and GET) are free.

jobs.math: Hetzner Object Storage stores files; it does not run background jobs
